description: The bar chart illustrates “Popularity” values for three content domains (Movies, Songs, Basketball) and breaks each domain into multiple bars corresponding to different models and answer/accuracy conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categorical domains labeled “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball,” arranged left to right in that order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Popularity” and uses a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks from about 20 up to 220 at regular intervals of 40 (20, 60, 100, 140, 180, 220). Within each domain, bars are grouped side-by-side and color-coded by model (blue for Llama3, red for Qwen2, yellow/orange for ChatGPT), with additional visual patterning indicated by the legend for conditions “Acc=0 & GT Ans,” “Acc=0 & Gene Ans,” and “Acc=1 & GT Ans” (shown as different hatch/fill styles); each model appears with multiple patterned bars per domain. In Movies, the bars cluster roughly between the mid-20s and mid-40s in popularity, with blue (Llama3) bars around the low-to-high 30s, red (Qwen2) bars around the high 20s to mid-40s, and yellow/orange (ChatGPT) bars around the high 20s to mid-30s. In Songs, the grouped bars span a wider range, roughly from the mid-40s up to around the mid-80s, with Llama3 (blue) including bars near ~50–70, Qwen2 (red) including bars near ~60–85, and ChatGPT (yellow/orange) including bars near ~45–75. In Basketball, the bars are tallest overall, ranging approximately from about 100 up to just above 200, with Llama3 (blue) bars around ~100, ~150, and ~180, Qwen2 (red) bars around ~100, ~190, and ~210, and ChatGPT (yellow/orange) bars around ~100, ~170, and ~140. The bars are not presented as a single sorted sequence by height; instead they are arranged as repeated grouped sets within each domain, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the use of distinct colors and hatch patterns tied to the legend.
